title: Majestic Puzzle
reviewNotes: Three branches, 19 exact positions from a separately reconstructed six-piece source diagram at 138s. Kc7 preserves a legal king move, whereas immediate b6 stalemates. Pawn exchange renews the passed b-pawn and leads to the selected Qb6 mate; king alternative reaches actual b8=Q mate with a6 still blocking its king. Earlier bishop plan and exchanges remain context.
